name: Right And Wrong
overview: Scripture reveals that human judgment about right and wrong is often flawed, as what seems right to man can lead to death (Proverbs 14:12). God commands the training of children in the proper way so they will not depart from it in old age (Proverbs 22:6). The Bible warns against confusing good and evil, light and darkness, emphasizing the seriousness of moral clarity (Isaiah 5:20). Jesus teaches the principle of treating others as we desire to be treated, summarizing the law and the prophets (Matthew 7:12), while highlighting that what defiles a person comes from within (Mark 7:20). Ultimately, the condemnation lies in loving darkness rather than the light given through Christ because of evil deeds (John 3:19).
